Given n vertices and undirected edges, return whether vertices can be assigned two colors with opposite colors across every edge. Disconnected graphs and self-loops are allowed.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    3,
    [
      [
        0,
        1
      ],
      [
        1,
        2
      ],
      [
        2,
        0
      ]
    ]
  ],
  "expected": false
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    4,
    [
      [
        0,
        1
      ],
      [
        2,
        3
      ]
    ]
  ],
  "expected": true
}
Hint

Every component needs its own initial color.

Complexity: O(V+E) time and space
